payload.meets_need:
KILLER — EVERY NEED'S PASS LINES, WALKED ONE BY ONE AGAINST THE PASS LINE RATHER THAN THE TITLE. Twelve needs: SEVEN met, THREE met in part, ONE unexercised, ONE NOT MET.

MET — the pass line demonstrated, not argued:
  N1 read any source the process mandates. Pass line: the design document and the predecessor system read through the lane, ONE call each, in an iteration where no script is written to do it. DEMONSTRATED: se-v2-design.md read by range (2586 lines, extent reported); ref `main` searched, engage.md line 64 returned. One call each.
  N2 find things without four attempts, WITH CONTEXT. Pass line: locating a known line takes ONE call and returns surrounding context. MET throughout this walk; the corrected pass line names the thing rather than the outcome, so no design can satisfy it by redefining it.
  N4 edit many sites at once. Pass line: six call sites change in one atomic hash-guarded call, and the log shows one call rather than a script. EXCEEDED: eleven edits across six files (the console sweep) and ten across five (the fixture rounds), each one call.
  N5 search what shipped. Pass line: a term existing ONLY in a closed iteration's evidence is found through the lane without checking out a branch. DEMONSTRATED: ref `iter/i8c-phone-connect` returned raid-answer-forgery.md line 21 — a file present in no working tree.
  N7 a lint never parks an unattended run. Pass line: no lint has a third outcome. MET — every check yields pass, fail or defer-with-reason.
  N10 a gate is reviewed, not just filled. Pass line has TWO halves and both are met: no gate can be submitted without all four rounds, enforced by the form; AND a mechanical check asserts every gate in the machine carries them as REQUIRED. The second half is a property over the whole machine, which is what makes it survive a gate authored later.
  N11 a reopen verdict does something. Pass line: re-activates the cone, marks prior fills superseded, and LEAVES THE EVIDENCE READABLE — proven by reopening and then finding the first pass's claims still on disk. MET TWICE, and stronger than the pass line asks: the superseded evidence was not merely found, it was USED as the working source for a gate's own review.
  N12 the red-team round names a kill-criterion. Pass line: every redteam_round names the criterion that would make the decision wrong. MET by inspection across all six gates. Weaker than the others by nature — it constrains form, not sincerity — and recorded as such rather than overstated.

MET IN PART — and the part that is missing is named:
  N6 mechanical checks are mechanical. Pass line names three checks that must be decided by a lint: models-adhered, red-observed, and the requirement-field check. The models-adhered check DEFERS rather than deciding, because functions and elements are prose rather than nodes. Two of three decide; one defers with its reason. The deferral is correct behaviour and it is still a pass line unmet.
  N9 the audit distinguishes computed from asserted. The distinction is recorded and a computed label without its fact is refused. But the computed SET is small, so the distinction carries less than the need intends. Structurally met, thin in practice, same cause as N6.
  N8 the record survives carelessness. Pass line: after deleting every iteration tag locally, a closed iteration's evidence is still reachable from trunk by hash. The MECHANISM is built and tested — annotated tags, the commit hash recorded in the grant, the branch deleted so one name means one thing. The SCENARIO was not staged: I did not delete the project's tags to watch recovery work. Recorded as unexercised rather than claimed.

NOT MET:
  N3 know the rules that bind this step. Pass line: a packet at a state to which a law applies CARRIES it, resolved, without the agent searching. NOTHING CARRIES IT. The join is unbuilt. This is the iteration's largest gap, it is the vision's own indictment, and it is unchanged from the day the iteration opened.
payload.killers_demonstrated:
FOUR KILLER USE CASES. TWO EXERCISED END TO END, ONE PARTIAL, ONE THAT CANNOT BE STAGED.

D1 — THE KILLER SEQUENCE (UC-B). EXERCISED END TO END IN THIS MILESTONE, three legs, three lane calls, no script:
  the design document read BY RANGE with its total extent reported;
  the predecessor system read BY REF `main`, nothing checked out;
  a CLOSED iteration's evidence found by searching ref `iter/i8c-phone-connect`, returning a file that exists in no working tree.
  The third leg is the one that changed the most: since the close-and-merge split, every shipped iteration's record had been invisible to search.

D2 — THE GATE THAT REVIEWS ITSELF TO A REOPEN (UC-A). EXERCISED TWICE, BOTH UNSTAGED, which is better evidence than any staged run:
  gate_inputs found three needs with no story, reopened write_stories, the states re-walked, the gate then passed, and the superseded fills stayed readable.
  gate_candidates probed its own veto, found the claim false, reopened evaluate_set, and the re-walk both restored a candidate AND surfaced a capability gap that two prior passes had missed.
  AND THE PART A STAGED DEMO WOULD HAVE CONCEALED: carrying out the first reopen DEADLOCKED the machine, and the fix for that deadlocked it differently. Both silent. Both now covered by a property generated over every state of the real machine and verified to catch each with its fix disabled.

D3 — THE SECOND AGENT (UC-D). PARTIAL. The mechanism is exercised six times with five refusals, each restoring trunk untouched and naming what failed. Two agents running at once has never happened. Mechanism proven, scenario unexercised, and I am not calling that a pass.

D4 — THE LAW MINTED THIS AFTERNOON (UC-H). CANNOT BE STAGED. There is nothing to run. A killer demonstration that cannot exist is the clearest possible statement of what did not ship, and it is recorded that way rather than softened.
payload.acceptance_converted:
EXECUTABLE SLICES CONVERTED TO PERMANENT ACCEPTANCE SCENARIOS — they run in the battery forever, not once at validation.

CONVERTED:
  D2's two properties — a reopen never strands a downstream gate; a reopened state completes and moves on. Generated over EVERY state of the real systematic machine rather than over the two shapes that broke. Verified against their own bar: with each fix disabled in turn, each fails naming the right failure.
  The gate-rounds property — every gate in the machine carries all four rounds as required. A property over the whole machine, which is what makes N10's second half real rather than a claim about today.
  D1's third leg — ref-scoped search and read, pinned by tests including one asserting a binary file cannot produce a malformed record.
  D3's rules — six promotion tests covering trunk-current, engine-files-only, red-suite, empty-suite, missing-file and empty-set.
  The operator obligation — no spawn may pop a console window, checked over source.

NOT CONVERTED, with reasons:
  N8's scenario. Converting it means deleting tags and verifying recovery. Doable as a fixture, not done — and I would rather say so than write a test that stages a weaker version and calls the need met.
  D3's parallel scenario. Two agents at once cannot be a unit test; it will be exercised by use.
  D4. Nothing to convert.
  N12's sincerity. Deliberately not converted — any check would count words, which is the unearned mechanical label the register forbids.
payload.consistency_swept:
THE SURFACES AGREE WITH THE BEHAVIOUR. Eight changes, each with its surface:
  Identifiers expanded → brand/voice.md gains an Identifiers section. This is the one that matters most: the rule lived in agent memory, which does not travel between machines and does not survive a fresh session — the same defect this iteration is about, one level up, applied to the rule telling me to communicate readably. Known and accepted cost: voice.md is embedded in the contract, so the contract hash changes and every session re-attests.
  The search architecture reversed → the new decision records it and the superseded one was rewritten IN PLACE to say why its conclusion fell and what of its analysis survives.
  Four new tools → swept automatically. The contract's lane list is generated from the served registry, so it cannot name a lane the surface does not serve. A hand-written list would already be wrong.
  The review rounds → swept at the source, and the rubric lives in the field DESCRIPTIONS rather than in a note the agent must find. This iteration's own principle applied to itself.
  Reopen, promotion, the one-click definition → each has a decision node carrying its cost and its known limit.
  The console obligation → swept as a LINT rather than a doc, because a deliberate choice that must survive future edits gets a check, not a comment.
NOT SWEPT, deliberately: the entry point script (owner ruled it correct as-is), method content (on the binding excluded list — where a note and the machine disagreed, I changed the MACHINE), and the book and README (nothing here is visible to a stranger).
THE GAP THE SWEEP ITSELF EXPOSES: it worked because I remembered what changed. Nothing mechanically checks that a change reached its describing surface.
payload.gaps_logged:
FIVE REGISTER ENTRIES, each with an owner and a trigger:
  se.raid-the-killer-story-that-could-not-be-demonstrated — owner: the next iteration, already ruled and scoped. Trigger: closed when a packet demonstrably carries a rule the agent did not go looking for.
  se.raid-the-parallel-agent-scenario-is-unexercised — owner: whoever first runs two iterations at once. Becomes urgent the moment anyone fans chunks out to sub-agents.
  se.raid-the-register-is-silent-about-operating-the-system — three gaps on one axis, none found by a gate. The owner appears in the stories as someone who READS the record, never as someone who OPERATES the tool.
  se.raid-a-criterion-ran-at-full-weight-with-no-definition — with its second-order lesson: a flip turning on someone's INTENT deserves more weight than one turning on a measurement. The same mistake is recorded one milestone earlier. Twice in one iteration.
  se.raid-the-engine-inherits-everything-by-default — three defects, one cause, fixed as a blacklist where the owner's law requires a whitelist.
Three things were deliberately NOT minted because they already live somewhere: the colon-in-path edge, the chunk-machine debt, and the promotion's diagnosis work.
payload.verify_round:
BUILT IT RIGHT. Three input states since the last gate, each opened and read against its claim.

1. fill_story_evidence — read. Claims ten stories walked, eight filled, one partial, one unfillable. Verified by re-walking the pass lines myself rather than accepting the summary, and the re-walk CHANGED the count: the state claimed eight filled, and against the strict pass lines it is seven clear, three partial, one unexercised, one failed. N6 and N9 are marked filled in the story walk but their pass lines are only partly met, because the models-adhered check defers. I have corrected the count in this gate rather than inheriting it. That is the verify round doing its job on the state immediately before it.

2. sweep_consistency — read, and spot-checked rather than trusted: voice.md does now carry the Identifiers section; the superseded search decision does carry its own account of why it fell. Both verified by opening the files.

3. log_gaps — read. Five entries, each with owner and trigger, all present in the ledger. Verified the three deliberate omissions genuinely live elsewhere rather than being dropped.

4. THE DEMONSTRATIONS — not asserted. D1 was executed during this milestone and its three results are in the session record: a range read reporting 2586 total lines, a ref search returning engage.md line 64, and a record search returning raid-answer-forgery.md line 21.

5. THE REGISTER AND THE FRAME — re-read for the pass lines, because this gate's killer is measured against them and quoting a need's TITLE instead of its PASS LINE is the easiest way to pass this gate dishonestly.

A BLESS IS NOT PROOF: gate_implementation passed with overrides. Its overridden items are still recorded as unmet here — in the gate that is the acceptance act and would most like them settled.
payload.validate_round:
BUILT THE RIGHT THING — against the frame, the vision and the register.

WHAT IS MISSING: N3, and it is the vision's own headline. The vision said the lane cannot open the two documents the process requires, the most-used tool applies one edit per call, and four laws minted this afternoon will never reach a packet. THE FIRST TWO ARE FIXED AND DEMONSTRATED. THE THIRD IS NOT. That is an honest two-thirds of the stated ambition.

WHAT IS PARTIAL: N6, N9 — both on the same blocker, items being prose rather than nodes. And N8, whose mechanism is built and whose scenario was not staged.

WHAT IS WRONG: one thing, found in this gate's own verify round — the preceding state's story walk claimed more filled slides than the strict pass lines support. Corrected here rather than inherited.

WHAT IS OUT OF SCOPE: nothing added at M8.

ASKS NO CHECK COVERED: no new ones this milestone. The three from earlier are now one register entry naming the pattern rather than three loose incidents.

AGAINST THE GOAL SYSTEM, and this is the fairest summary of the iteration:
  G5 (a review happens because something asks for it) — MET, and it is the iteration's real product. Six gates, and every one produced a finding or a question its author had missed. Two verdicts were REOPEN. One gate corrected the previous gate's account.
  G2 (compute what can be computed) — ADVANCED. Four properties crossed from 'someone must remember' to 'the suite refuses'.
  G1 (the lane wins on merit) — MIXED, and the honest reading is that it got worse before it got better. Six scripts were still written, five promotions refused, two deadlocks cost hours. The lane is better than this morning and it is not yet the path of least resistance.
  G3/G4 (every rule reaches the agent it binds; the record survives carelessness) — G4 mechanically met and unexercised; G3 NOT MET, which is N3.
payload.redteam_round:
THE OPPOSING CASE, in increasing strictness. This gate is the acceptance act, so it gets the full weight.

FIRST: one of the four killer use cases cannot be demonstrated at all, and this gate's killer criterion is that every need's pass lines are demonstrated. One need is flatly unmet. On the plainest reading this gate does not pass.
  THAT READING IS DEFENSIBLE and I will not argue it away. The counter is narrow: the unmet need is unmet because its mechanism was deliberately NOT BUILT rather than built badly, the decision to leave it was made at a gate with its dissent recorded, and the owner has since designed the successor and ruled it a separate iteration. So the gap is scoped, owned and destined — not discovered here. That makes it an override, not a pass.

SECOND, STRICTER: seven of twelve needs clearly met is a modest result for a day's work, and the framing throughout this iteration has been generous to itself — 'the rounds worked', 'the reopen proved itself'. A colder reading: the iteration spent most of its effort discovering and repairing defects IN ITS OWN NEW MACHINERY. Two reopen deadlocks, five promotion refusals, three environment-inheritance defects. Much of what was 'proven' was proven by first breaking it.
  I THINK THAT READING IS LARGELY RIGHT, and it belongs in the record. What I would add rather than subtract: every one of those defects was in machinery that did not exist this morning, and each is now covered by a check that catches it. The alternative was not a clean build — it was the same machinery shipping unexamined, which is exactly what happened to the review rounds for the project's entire history.

THIRD, STRICTEST: this bless IS the sign-off, and it is being given by the agent whose work is being accepted, on an iteration about making agents' self-blessing trustworthy. There is no independence anywhere in the chain. The rounds constrain form; they cannot manufacture a second party. Every finding in this iteration was found by me, argued by me, and adjudicated by me.
  The only honest mitigations: the findings are specific and checkable rather than atmospheric; the unmet items are stated in the terms of their own pass lines rather than in mine; the count in this gate is WORSE than the state before it claimed, because the verify round corrected it downward; and the owner has intervened four times today, each time changing something material — which is the closest thing to independence this arrangement has, and it worked every time.

CITED RUBRIC: the need register's pass lines, and this gate's own statement that the bless is the acceptance act with no second sign-off artifact. The operative test is whether the system meets the need — not whether it improved.

KILL-CRITERION for PASS: that a need is claimed as met whose pass line is not actually demonstrated. This is the exact failure mode of an acceptance gate. I hunted it by re-walking all twelve pass lines rather than reading the previous state's summary, and it FIRED — N6 and N9 were carried as filled and are partial. Corrected downward. After correction: not met.
SECOND KILL-CRITERION: that a demonstration was described rather than run. D1 was executed in this milestone with three results in the record; D2 occurred twice unstaged. D3 and D4 are marked partial and impossible respectively. Not met.

HONEST WEAKNESS: six gates, six findings, all in my own work. The rounds are the only reason any of them surfaced, and they are also the only instrument judging whether they were handled well.
payload.verdict:
PASS WITH NOTED OVERRIDES. This bless is the acceptance act, and it accepts an iteration that did about two-thirds of what it set out to do.

THE OVERRIDES, logged WITH their dissent:

1. N3 IS NOT MET, AND IT IS A KILLER. A packet still does not carry the rules that bind the step in hand. The vision's own indictment — four laws minted this afternoon will never reach a packet — is as true tonight as this morning, and this iteration minted ten notes and four laws that will reach nobody.
  THE DISSENT: on the plainest reading of this gate's killer, this should reopen and build it. Carried instead because the mechanism was deliberately NOT built rather than built on a guessed selector, the decision was taken at a gate with its dissent recorded, and the owner has designed the successor in full and ruled it a separate iteration. The gap is scoped, owned and destined.

2. THREE NEEDS ARE PARTIAL. N6 and N9 rest on the same blocker — items are prose rather than nodes, so the model-adherence check defers and the computed set stays thin. N8's mechanism is built and its scenario was never staged.
  Note that this count is WORSE than the preceding state claimed. Its story walk carried N6 and N9 as filled; re-walking the pass lines rather than the titles corrected them downward. An acceptance gate that inherits its own inputs' optimism is not an acceptance gate.

3. TWO KILLER DEMONSTRATIONS ARE INCOMPLETE. D3's mechanism is proven six times over and its scenario — two agents at once — has never run. D4 cannot be staged at all.

WHAT IS ACCEPTED, and it is not nothing:
  Seven needs met against their pass lines, including both halves of N10 and a stronger-than-asked N11.
  D1 exercised end to end, three legs, no script — including a search of a shipped iteration's record, which was unreachable by any tool in the lane this morning.
  D2 exercised twice, unstaged, and its two properties converted into permanent acceptance scenarios generated over every state of the real machine.
  226 checks green in trunk, and that green is worth more than this morning's equivalent because a run that executes nothing now counts as failed.
  Four properties moved from 'someone must remember' to 'the suite refuses'.

THE THING THIS ITERATION ACTUALLY PROVED, stated plainly because it is the reason to accept it: every gate here found something its author had missed, and two of them sent the work back. For the whole prior history of this project, gates were blessed without a single one of the four rounds their own method required — and they all passed. That difference is the deliverable.

M9 closes.
